title: Harvest and Bell
author: Q. M. Sandoval
blurb: Xanthe Lockridge, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must finish the ritual the founders started before the frost writes its final pattern.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
